title: Number ranges
subtitle: How your business numbers its documents: one continuous sequence per document type across all locations.
freezeNotice: A number range is frozen with the first number it hands out. After that its pattern, start value and yearly restart cannot be changed — only by Nexotec support, with a reason. Check the patterns before you create the first document.
loadError: The number ranges could not be loaded.
readOnly: Only the management can change number ranges.
patternHint: Placeholders: {year} for the year, {location_code} for the location code, exactly one {counter:N} for the counter with N digits. Otherwise letters, digits and - / . _ are allowed — at most 16 characters per number.
yearlyReset: Start again at the start value every year
frozenStaffNotice: This number range has handed out numbers already and is frozen. A change is a support intervention and is recorded with your reason.
previewError: No number can be shown for this pattern.
saveError: The number range could not be saved.
